claim: The Nālāgiri episode is attested in Pali Buddhist narrative transmission: Devadatta's release of a fierce elephant and its subduing by the Buddha form a recognized teaching story, but an elephant scene without a readable local caption remains an iconographic identification rather than proof of one historical event.
bounded_by: The textual tradition is clear; the exact match to ILL-KANDY-08 remains medium-confidence because the temple caption was not captured.
notes: Run24 closes the textual-tradition target but not the local-caption target.
